_note: Machine-checkable record of standing governance decisions that change what the bundle discloses or how a gate behaves. A decision carries a signer, a date, a scope and an `invalidates_when` condition that can be evaluated mechanically; a decision whose condition evaluates true is EXPIRED until re-affirmed. Prose elsewhere is not a decision record.

decisions.topic: Strain-identifier disclosure in the public software release
decisions.decision: Cohort strain identifiers (the AS- series) may appear in shipped code, tests and documentation. What the software release withholds is: genome assemblies and annotation inputs; unpublished genome-scale novelty determinations tied to a named strain; personal identifiers of people and institutions other than the published author.
decisions.rationale: Verified against the sealed CODE tier before ruling: no cohort genome or assembly ships (synthetic fixtures and public reference seeds only); no host, collection or geolocation detail is paired with any identifier; strain-to-genus is already public through GenBank 16S records; BGC-level statements the engine emits are class-level and judgment-deferred by construction. An identifier that discloses nothing meaningful does not need scrubbing, and blanket identifier rewriting measurably broke the in-tier test suite when tried.
decisions.primary_artifact: docs/PUBLIC_RELEASE_GUIDE.md (what ships / what is withheld) + tools/public_release_audit.py (the withheld classes are the gate's banned classes) + the owner signature block in this file (2026-09-04 16:20 Pacific)
decisions.current_effect: AS_SCRUB=0 (identifier rewrite retired); the read-only identifier leak audit still runs and can fail a cut on a genuinely private prefix (AJS-, PENDING-).
decisions.invalidates_when: a genuinely private cohort (unpublished genomes, or any series the owner marks private) is admitted to a tier that can be published
decisions.remediation_available: Set AS_SCRUB=1 to re-arm the identifier rewrite; the machinery (tools/make_public_tier.sh, tools/redact_public_tier.py) is intact and needs no code change.

decisions.topic: Engine version boundary for Mode B card-structure gate behaviour
decisions.decision: The engine integer marks a score-comparability boundary, not a validation boundary. Gate behaviour that changes no scored field, parser or rule ships under a bundle bump only, with a forward-only lineage stanza.
decisions.asserted_signer: release owner (delegated to the sealing lane)
decisions.rationale: The card-structure gate is not in the reproducibility fingerprint and no scored field reads its verdict; existing sealed artifacts keep their verdicts.
decisions.invalidates_when: a gate verdict enters the reproducibility fingerprint or feeds a scored field

decisions.topic: Identifier controls: rewrite removed, audit retained
decisions.decision: The identifier rewrite pass (which mutates a release) is removed; the identifier leak audit (which observes one) is retained and can fail a cut.
decisions.asserted_signer: release owner (delegated to the sealing lane)
decisions.rationale: A mutation nobody runs is dead weight; the observation is the only control that would notice a private identifier entering a public tier.
decisions.invalidates_when: a genuinely private cohort is introduced and the rewrite must be re-armed

decisions.topic: Companion phylogenomics binaries reported by doctor
decisions.decision: `mamey doctor` reports GToTree / IQ-TREE / fastANI presence. GToTree is GPL-3 and is never vendored, so its absence must be visible before a run rather than discovered during one.
decisions.asserted_signer: release owner (delegated to the sealing lane)
decisions.invalidates_when: the companion-tool and external-data registries are merged
